title: Plan for OD-1
body:
The steward could not write the OD-1 plan without the tool external interface being fixed, so it files BL-5 instead: the command-line invocation syntax, HIGH risk, with a proposed default. docs/DESIGN.md sections 8 and 11 leave both the positional order and how batch mode is invoked deliberately undecided, and the planning layer files rather than settles them.

Opened by the delivery driver on base run/web.
